document.abstract: On 30 November 2020 (11.59 p.m.), Hong Kong decided to proceed with switching off analog television services. Thus, on 1 December 2020 (00.00), Hong Kong entered an era of full digital TV broadcasting. Before the analog switch off (ASO), the Hong Kong Section organized a webinar on 27 November, titled “ASO – Full digital TV Broadcasting in Hong Kong.”
